title: Personal Checking: paper checks and stop payment pricing by tier
content:
## Scope

This card shows, per Personal Checking tier, whether paper checks can be written on the account, the fee for a stop payment order or a stop payment renewal beyond the free allowance, and how many stop payment orders and renewals are placed free of charge in each statement cycle.

## Terms by tier

| Tier | Paper checks can be written | Stop payment fee per order or renewal beyond the free allowance (USD) | Stop payment orders and renewals free per statement cycle |
|---|---|---|---|
| Access Checking | No (checkless account) | 32.00 | 0 |
| Student Checking | Yes | 32.00 | 0 |
| Everyday Checking | Yes | 32.00 | 0 |
| Interest Checking | Yes | 32.00 | 1 |
| Premier Checking | Yes | 32.00 | 2 |
| Private Client Checking | Yes | 32.00 | 5 |

## Basis Q&A

**Q: What does "checkless" mean for Access Checking?**
A: Paper checks cannot be written on an Access Checking account.

**Q: Is the stop payment fee lower on the higher tiers?**
A: No. The fee is 32.00 USD on every tier; what differs is the number of orders and renewals placed free in each statement cycle.

**Worked comparison (hypothetical owners)**: an owner places two stop payment orders in one statement cycle.

| Tier | Free allowance | Orders beyond the allowance | Fees at 32.00 USD each |
|---|---|---|---|
| Everyday Checking | 0 | 2 | 64.00 USD |
| Interest Checking | 1 | 1 | 32.00 USD |
| Premier Checking | 2 | 0 | 0.00 USD |
